a. The type of data structure that IszCool Solutions should use for this purpose is a hash table.

b. Hash table is an appropriate data structure for this purpose because it allows for fast and efficient storage and retrieval of data. Each piece of data, such as the student ID, parent's name, credit card information, etc. would be stored as a key-value pair. The keys in this case would be the unique identifiers, such as the student ID or the parent's email address, while the values would be the associated data, such as the parent's name or credit card number. Hash tables use a hash function to map the keys to their corresponding values, allowing for fast and efficient access to the data. This makes it ideal for storing and manipulating data in real-time applications, such as an online ordering system. Hash tables are also a good data structure for data that needs to be stored temporarily before it is written to a file or database because it's data manipulation time complexity is O(1) which makes it fast.
<!-- SOURCE_TURN_002_END -->

a. The other two control structures that will be used to develop the software solution for the IszCool Canteen app are:

* Selection control structure: This control structure allows the software to make decisions based on certain conditions. For example, if a student's order is more than the daily limit set by the parent, the selection control structure would be used to display a message or reject the order.
* Iteration control structure: This control structure allows the software to repeat a set of instructions multiple times. For example, when processing a student's order, the iteration control structure would be used to check each item in the order and make sure it is available on the menu.

b. The selection control structure would be the most appropriate control structure in this case. This is because the canteen staff need to make a decision based on certain conditions, such as if an item is unavailable or if a student's order exceeds the daily limit. The selection control structure would allow the staff to check for these conditions and make the necessary adjustments to the order accordingly. This will make sure the orders are placed and processed correctly and with the least human error.

a. One physical security control that could protect the development of the IszCool Canteen app is to limit access to the development room or area to authorized personnel only. This can be done by using security measures such as security cameras, card readers, or keypads to restrict access to the room. Another physical security control that can be used is to store the laptops or desktops that are used for testing and editing in a locked cabinet or a room.

One software security control that could protect the development of the IszCool Canteen app is to use a password-protected user authentication system. This would ensure that only authorized personnel, such as the development team, can access the software and prevent unauthorised access by people other than the development team.

b. One way to ensure that there is always a working version of the IszCool Canteen app accessible to the development team is by using a version control system. A version control system is a software tool that manages and keeps track of changes made to the software over time. The development team can use this tool to check out, edit, and check in the latest version of the software. This allows the team to collaborate on the software development and ensures that the most recent, stable version of the software is always available to the team. Additionally, the version control system can also provide a history of the changes made to the software, making it easy to trace and fix any issues that may arise.
<!-- SOURCE_TURN_010_END -->
